title: Arc 5/5: migrate the 12 Story documents and amend ADR-0009
summary: This repo's own docs, plus the superseding amendment the live ADR needs.
description: Migrate the 12 verified docs/ files carrying type: Story (list on LCLI-552). lore-spec.md and test/fixtures/okf-bundle/stories/adopt-lore.md are spec prose and fixture content -- scope separately, do not fold in. ADR-0009 is LIVE for the Story<->Task naming and coupling decision and needs a superseding amendment per this repo's ADR immutability convention, NOT a silent edit; its status-vocabulary clause was already superseded by ADR-0022 under LCLI-506, which is unrelated and must not be conflated. Migration must RE-STAMP modelines deliberately: a lore rewrite DESTROYS the modeline rather than repointing it (ADR-0011 §2).
